Quds English thesaurus data pack

Open English WordNet, regular 2025 lexical edition.
Copyright (c) 2019-present, The Open English WordNet Team.
Source: https://en-word.net/ and https://github.com/globalwordnet/english-wordnet
OEWN development: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.
Underlying Princeton WordNet: the original WordNet license applies.
Princeton WordNet: https://wordnet.princeton.edu/

Quds changes, 18 November 2026: deterministic conversion of WN-LMF into
indexed, compressed JSON meaning groups; original synset, lexical-entry and
sense IDs retained; source Form records become lookup-only aliases; labels
are resolved from explicit source usage/region relations. No external ranking
corpus, proper-name expansion or generated synonyms is included.
Original source spellings, definitions, examples and typed relations are kept.

English inflected lookup uses 4,473 source Form records and independently
encoded Princeton WordNet morphy suffix rules, requiring a compatible POS
in the installed lexicon. This is finite, uncontextualized lookup, not
grammatical reinflection or agreement checking.
Morphy reference: https://wordnet.princeton.edu/documentation/morphy7wn

The independent Quds implementation is MIT. Data retains the terms above.
See OEWN_LICENSE.md, WNDB_License.txt and CC_BY_4.0.txt in this directory.
